name: agentcast
description: Stream your Claude Code session to a shareable live link served from your own Cloudflare account. Viewers watch prompts, replies, tool calls and diffs as they happen, then replay when it ends.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: Your agentcast Worker, e.g. https://agentcast.<you>.workers.dev. /agentcast:deploy fills this in. Nothing streams until it is set.

create_token.title: Create token
create_token.description: Secret your server requires before it will create a session. /agentcast:deploy generates and stores it.

passphrase.title: Viewer passphrase
passphrase.description: If set, viewers must enter this before anything loads. Leave empty for link-only access.

ai_summary.title: AI title and summary
ai_summary.description: When a session ends, generate a short title and summary with Workers AI (on by default).

enabled.title: Streaming enabled
enabled.description: Turn off to stop streaming without uninstalling (on by default).

retention.title: Link retention
retention.description: How long share links live: 24h (default), 7d, 30d, or forever. You can also keep or delete individual sessions with /agentcast:keep and /agentcast:delete.
